title: Ekinoks Hayalleri
author: Nurdan Bağrıaçık
description: Grandpa Lukas is the world’s most beloved storyteller, but he has run out of tales. When clever Torin inspires him, Lukas discovers a magical way to turn children’s dreams and wishes into new stories during the equinoxes. Filled with wonder, adventure, and heart, Equinox Dreams celebrates imagination, storytelling, and sharing dreams with the world. Its lyrical language and lively dialogue blend fantasy with gentle lessons about creativity, curiosity, friendship, and following one’s dreams.
